purpose: First fresh real-system test of calibration-only selective promotion after known-truth support.

focal_response.selection_basis: fixed ecological target chosen before opening sequence response; no response prevalence, effect direction or model score used
focal_response.binary_rule: 1 if one or more sequence rows assigned to the exact focal taxon link to that deployment, else 0
focal_response.duplicate_sequences: collapse to deployment-level binary presence; never use abundance

temporal_protocol.split_rule: Sort all 820 frozen deployment rows by start_date then deployment_id. First 60% are inner-train, next 20% inner-validation, final 20% untouched outer-heldout; integer boundaries are floor(0.60*N) and floor(0.80*N).
temporal_protocol.state_availability_rule: For a deployment starting at time t, EOG state may use only focal-positive source deployments whose end_date is strictly earlier than t. A deployment outcome enters state only after its end_date.

layer_b.nodes: distinct deployment coordinates; each deployment row receives the feature vector at its own coordinate
layer_b.distance: haversine kilometres between frozen deployment coordinates
layer_b.local_world_threshold_rule: Compute nearest-neighbour distance for each distinct coordinate using only frozen deployment geometry. Use the 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentiles of strictly positive nearest-neighbour distances as four local reachability thresholds; add one external_open world.
layer_b.world_compatibility: A surviving local world is eliminated when a newly available positive source coordinate has zero support from every previously available positive source coordinate under that threshold. external_open is never eliminated.
layer_b.support: binary source-to-node reachability within threshold; external_open support=1
layer_b.source_weighting: all distinct previously available focal-positive source coordinates, equal source weighting
layer_b.zero_source_rule: local support=0 and external_open support=1 before the first available positive source; no local world is eliminated until at least two temporally ordered positive source coordinates exist
layer_b.implementation_requirement: prediction representation must be invariant to source labels and world labels

selection.primary_metric: macro binary log loss across subproject_name values represented in the scoring split; labels=[0,1] for each subproject
selection.rule: Fit baseline and augmented on inner-train only. Promote Layer B if and only if augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline inner-validation macro log loss. Otherwise select baseline-only.
selection.final_fit: After the promotion decision is frozen, refit baseline and augmented on inner-train plus inner-validation using unchanged hyperparameters; score baseline, always-augmented and the preselected arm on untouched outer-heldout exactly once.
secondary: always_augmented minus baseline outer macro log loss
selected arm minus always-augmented outer macro log loss

interpretive_boundary.favorable_means: calibration-only selective promotion translated to lower untouched outer macro log loss than baseline in this fresh real system
interpretive_boundary.null_means: the frozen selector did not change untouched outer macro log loss relative to baseline
interpretive_boundary.adverse_means: the frozen selector produced higher untouched outer macro log loss than baseline in this fresh real system
